# Gifted Minds Scholars

> Gifted Minds Scholars (GMS) is a Pre-K through 5th grade tutoring program in Loganville, Georgia, USA, offering in-person and online tutoring in reading, math, writing and academic support. It is an educational tutoring program of BACB21Co, founded and led by Mrs. Wendy Bonnick, an educator with more than {{years}} years of experience in education.

Key facts:
- Grades served: Pre-K through 5th grade
- Formats: in person in Loganville, Georgia (convenient to {{nearby}}); online for families anywhere
- Programs: Reading & Literacy Development; Mathematics Tutoring; Writing & Language Arts; Academic Support & Enrichment (including support for dyslexia, ADHD and other learning differences)
- Hours (by appointment, subject to availability): Sunday 3:30–6:30 PM; Monday 3:30–6:30 PM; Tuesday 3:30–6:30 PM; Thursday 3:30–7:30 PM (US Eastern Time)
- Founder: Mrs. Wendy Bonnick, Founder & Educational Instructor. She believes her gift for teaching was given from God; her favorite scripture is Philippians 4:13, "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me."
- Enrollment: online inquiry form at {{siteUrl}}/enroll/ — families are contacted about scheduling and availability
- Phone: {{phone}}
- Email: {{email}}
- Parent organization: BACB21Co (https://www.bacb21.org)
- Pricing: not published; families are asked to inquire

## Pages
- [Home]({{siteUrl}}/): overview, programs, founder, schedule, parent feedback
- [Programs]({{siteUrl}}/programs/): all four tutoring programs
- [Reading & Literacy Tutoring]({{siteUrl}}/programs/reading-tutoring/): phonics, sight words, fluency, vocabulary, comprehension, spelling
- [Math Tutoring]({{siteUrl}}/programs/math-tutoring/): number recognition, operations, place value, fractions, decimals, word problems
- [Writing & Language Arts Tutoring]({{siteUrl}}/programs/writing-tutoring/): handwriting, sentences, grammar, punctuation, spelling, paragraphs, creative writing
- [Academic Support & Enrichment]({{siteUrl}}/programs/academic-support/): individualized, multisensory, differentiated support; dyslexia, ADHD and learning differences; enrichment
- [About Mrs. Wendy Bonnick]({{siteUrl}}/about/): founder background and philosophy
- [FAQ]({{siteUrl}}/faq/): common parent questions with direct answers
- [Enroll]({{siteUrl}}/enroll/): enrollment inquiry form
- [Contact]({{siteUrl}}/contact/): phone, email, location and hours
- [Brian A.C. Bonnick Scholarship]({{siteUrl}}/scholarship/): one-time $1,000 award for tuition, books or educational expenses; elementary through college; open Dec 15, 2026, deadline Apr 1, 2027; apply at https://www.bacb21.org/scholarship/
- [BACB21]({{siteUrl}}/bacb21/): parent organization BACB21Co, created by Wendy Bonnick to carry on the legacy of her late son, Brian A.C. Bonnick (2000–2021), founder of the Perfectly Stated apparel brand; funds sponsor less fortunate children with books, lunch and tuition
- [Tutoring in Loganville, GA]({{siteUrl}}/tutoring-loganville-ga/): local in-person tutoring, nearby communities served, hours
- [Scholar Zone]({{siteUrl}}/scholar-zone/): free practice app for Pre-K–5th grade with sight-word flashcards (Dolch lists), math-fact games and a reading log with stars and badges; progress saved on the device
- [Parent Resources]({{siteUrl}}/resources/): guides for parents
- [10 ways to help your child read at home]({{siteUrl}}/resources/help-child-read-at-home/)
- [7 signs your child might need a tutor]({{siteUrl}}/resources/signs-child-needs-tutor/)
- [In-person vs. online tutoring for elementary students]({{siteUrl}}/resources/in-person-vs-online-tutoring/)
